classes.name: referent
classes.label: referent
classes.definition: something that another concept stands for, exemplifies, symbolizes, or otherwise mentions

edges.name: causes
edges.label: causes
edges.definition: relationship between an event or set of events or factors (the cause) and a second event, phenomenon, situation, or result (the effect), where the second event or outcome is understood as a consequence of the first

edges.name: confers
edges.label: confers
edges.definition: grants or bestows by virtue of some authority

edges.name: controls
edges.label: controls
edges.definition: exercises authority or influence over

edges.name: embodies
edges.label: embodies
edges.definition: is an expression of, gives a tangible or visible form to (an idea, quality, or feeling), makes concrete and perceptible

edges.name: evaluates
edges.label: evaluates
edges.definition: assesses the nature, quality, or ability of someone or something

edges.name: exchanges
edges.label: exchanges
edges.definition: gives something in return something else

edges.name: exemplifies
edges.label: exemplifies
edges.definition: is a concrete realization or example of

edges.name: generates
edges.label: generates
edges.definition: produces through the application of one or more mathematical or logical steps or rules

edges.name: holds
edges.label: holds
edges.definition: is the relationship between a party and something it possesses, or over which it exercises some ownership or control or has at its discretion the ability to dispose of it as it sees fit

edges.name: involves
edges.label: involves
edges.definition: (of a situation or event) includes (something) as a necessary part or result

edges.name: is caused by
edges.label: is caused by
edges.definition: is the relationship between an event (the effect) and a second event (the cause), where the first event is understood as a consequence of the second; also, the relationship between a set of factors (causes) and a phenomenon (the effect)

edges.name: is conferred by
edges.label: is conferred by
edges.definition: a relationship between a right or obligation and the vehicle, such as an agreement or contract, that vests (or confers) said right or obligation

edges.name: is controlled by
edges.label: is controlled by
edges.definition: is influenced, managed, or directed by

edges.name: is evaluated by
edges.label: is evaluated by
edges.definition: is ascertained or determined by

edges.name: is exemplified by
edges.label: is exemplified by
edges.definition: is made concrete or is realized by

edges.name: is generated by
edges.label: is generated by
edges.definition: identifies some party or something that produces something via some equation, logic, or rules

edges.name: is held by
edges.label: is held by
edges.definition: indicates the party that possesses and has at least partial control of something, regardless of ownership

edges.name: is issued by
edges.label: is issued by
edges.definition: indicates a functional entity or party responsible for circulating, distributing, or publishing something

edges.name: is mandated by
edges.label: is mandated by
edges.definition: relates a responsibility, capacity, or action to that which requires it

edges.name: is produced by
edges.label: is produced by
edges.definition: identifies the producer that fabricates, manufactures or otherwise creates something through some production process

edges.name: issues
edges.label: issues
edges.definition: officially makes something available

edges.name: mandates
edges.label: mandates
edges.definition: relates something to a commitment, contract, law, obligation, requirement, regulation, or similar concept that requires it

edges.name: produces
edges.label: produces
edges.definition: creates through a fabrication, manufacturing or production process

attributes.name: has alias
attributes.label: has alias
attributes.definition: indicates an alternate name of by which something is known

attributes.name: has common name
attributes.label: has common name
attributes.definition: indicates a name by which something is frequently referred, without reference to any formal usage or structure

attributes.name: has formal name
attributes.label: has formal name
attributes.definition: indicates a name by which something is known for some official purpose or context, or which is structured in some way such as to always follow the same format regardless of usage

attributes.name: has legal name
attributes.label: has legal name
attributes.definition: specifies the name used to refer to a party in legal communications

attributes.name: was formerly known as
attributes.label: was formerly known as
attributes.definition: indicates a name by which something was known in the past
